# dsh-miliastra v0.6.4

**安装**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.4` → **重启 `dsh web`**（Host + Client 两边都改了）
**Install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-miliastra@0.6.4`, then **restart `dsh web`** (both halves changed).

[中文](#cn-v0.6.4) | [English](#en-v0.6.4)

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.4">🚀 新增功能</h3>

- ★ **预制效果的模拟器改成独立会话**：Host 本来就按会话分控制器（`registry` 键 = `ctx.sessionId`），
  但面板与 AI 都传空 ctx ⇒ 大家共用 `'default'` 那一份工程，于是"预制效果预览"会**改掉**模拟器页 / AI 正在用的工程。
  现在 `/miliastra/engine` 认 `__session`、`/miliastra/play?session=<名>` 把会话名**盖进页面**（页脚显示 `· 会话 presets`），
  预制效果页固定用 **`presets`** 会话 ⇒ 与模拟器页、与 AI **完全互不影响**。⚠️ 代价：多一份运行时（多一个 Worker）。 @LoktLin
- ★ **预制效果做二级分类 + 4 个组合预设**：一级 **粒子 / 图元**，二级 **光与火 / 天气 / 收集与庆祝 / 形态与轨迹 / 组合 / 形状沿路径**；
  面板下拉按 `<optgroup label="一级 · 二级">` 分组，`preset:"list"` 每条带 `category`/`sub`/`isCombo`，并多一段 `categories` 摘要。
  @LoktLin
  - **4 个组合预设**（多层同屏，层**全部来自已验证的预设**，只错开 `delay`、换 `id`/`seed`）：
    `combo-star-burst`（星光爆发）· `combo-coin-fountain`（金币喷泉）· `combo-snow-blossom`（雪中花瓣）· `combo-peacock-finale`（孔雀终幕）。
    ⚠️ **池子按最费的那层算**（64~104）：第一版凭感觉写 60，`preflight` 当场报「池 60 < 需要 64」—— 真机上会抢槽位、画面缺粒。
    合计控件 **384~416**（总预算 1024 的 37.5%~40.6%）。
    ⚠️ **一个组合共用一张贴图**（生成器一份工程只写一个 `IMAGE_ID`），所以每组都从同一贴图号的预设里挑；
    "每层不同贴图"要改生成器，**没做**（回执与文档都写着）。
  - 预设总数 **13 → 17 粒子**（+3 图元 = **20**）；下拉以前只列粒子，现在把 3 个图元也列出来。
  - 工具 schema 里 `preset` 的说明同步改（按规矩跑了 `gen-readme-tools.mjs --write`）；schema **31.9 KB**，仍在 32 KB 棘轮内。

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.4-improve">🎨 体验优化</h3>

- **初级功能页重排**：删掉「关卡」选择器与「关卡与文件」那张 8 行元信息卡 ⇒ 换成一行大字
  （`原神 · 关卡ID` + 几个活文件 / 地图多大 / 日志几局）。面板从此**永远自动跟随**当前图
  （**工具侧不变**：AI deploy 时仍必须显式带 `level`）。 @LoktLin
  - ★ **新增「整体存盘状态」卡**：一次 `miliastra_health {op:'sha',all:true}` 给**一句话**结论 ——
    ✅ `已存盘：N / N 个脚本与地图里嵌的一致` ｜ ⚠️ `有 M / N 个脚本没存盘`（**点名**）｜ ❔ `说不清`（缺 sha 时**不替它说已存盘**）；
    没挂进地图的（`mounted:false`）**单列**，不算"没存盘"。
  - **「代码操作」整块折进 `<details>`（默认收起）**：选活文件 / 体检 / 一致性 / 备份 / 还原 / 部署 —— **功能一个没少**。
  - 右栏归属：左 = ① 当前关卡 + 地图体检；右 = ② 存盘与进程（整体存盘状态 + 进程 + 代码操作）。
- **模拟器页瘦身**：删掉那条全宽横条（图标 +「模拟器」+ 就绪徽标 + 刷新），
  唯一有用的「刷新引擎状态」搬到**试玩页工具条**叫「刷新状态」（**错误提示那一行保留**）；
  左列四张卡（试玩日志 / 试玩操作 / 操作时间线 / 验收单）**不再渲染** —— 试玩控制与逐帧日志右边试玩页自己就有。
  ⚠️ **代码全保留、只摘渲染**（要加回来把它们放回 `playsideKids` 一行）；`导出 GIA` / `重置工程` 两个"面板里没别处可点"的动作搬进 ④ 折叠卡。 @LoktLin
- **「控件模板索引 / 容器节点索引」不再是两个一上来就要人填的怪输入框**：它们是**交接值**（已自动从本关 `.gil` 读好），
  现在默认只显示**一行只读值** + 一个「手填」按钮；**读不到时自动展开**两个输入框并说清缺什么（不许静默留空）。
  选了**图元**预设时会明说 `imageId` / 每层池对它不适用（填了也忽略）。 @LoktLin
- **README 换 4 张新截图**（初级功能 / 预制效果 / 像素画 / 网格计算）+ **修 5 处写错的事实**
  （`miliastra_code` 8→11 op、`miliastra_probe` 5 个只读脚本→7 个模板、`miliastra_asset` 10→11 op、
  `vfx-lua` 13→17 粒子+3 图元+二级分类、面板"三栏"→六个页面）；`docs/` **9 篇 → 7 篇**（两篇按作者要求清掉/挪到工作区）。 @LoktLin

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.4-fix">🐛 问题修复</h3>

- ★ **"预览之后啥都没"**（作者原话：「啥都没咋回事」）—— 两个原因叠在一起：
  ① **`slash-arc` 是 `loop:false` 的一次性预设**（1.2 秒播完）⇒ 之后再去看，舞台当然一直空着。
  现在面板会**明说**「这个预设是一次性的：播完就停，舞台会一直空着 —— 那不是坏了」，
  并多给一个 **「重播」** 按钮（= 把同一份 Lua **再 bind 一次**，运行时重建、脚本从第 0 帧重跑）；
  「重载画面」的说明也写清它**只重挂画面、不会重播动画**。 @LoktLin
  ② **面板把「图片号」发给了图元预设**（实测：作者手上的 `10005` —— 少一个 0）。图元**是吃 `imageId` 的**
  （`SetImage(…, 10005)` ⇒ 平台没这个号、模拟器也不画 ⇒ 什么都看不见）。根因是 **Host 的 `summaryOnly`
  只回 `{id, nameZh}`**，把分类字段砍掉了 ⇒ 面板认不出"这是图元"，于是照发。 @LoktLin
  - Host：`summaryOnly` 现在保留 `category`/`categoryLabel`/`sub`/`subLabel`/`isCombo`/`shapeKind`/`defaultLoop`
    （都是"选得动"的依据；实测仍只占完整回执的 **35.5%**：15 371 → 5 454 字节）。
  - 面板：拉回清单时**归一化 + 用内置静态表兜底**（旧版 Host 上也能正确分组 / 认出图元 / 判一次性）。
- **网格图缩放的滚轮陷阱**（作者原话：「这个滚轮咋把网格图也搞小了」）：原来是"光标在图上一滚就缩放"，
  于是想往下滚面板时，光标正好停在图上就把图缩到了 29%，看着像坏了。改成**通例**：
  **普通滚轮一律不缩放**（**不** `preventDefault`），**只有按住 Ctrl / ⌘ 才缩放**。 @LoktLin
  - 缩放下限从 **25% 抬到 50%**（缩到 25% 就成一条小带 = 把图弄丢了），上限照旧 800%；**读缓存时也过一遍夹取**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.6.4-chores">⚠️ 其他变更</h3>

- **Host 与 Client 两边都改了** ⇒ 装完/拉源码后**重启 `dsh web`**（不是 F5）；预制效果页会多一个独立会话（多一个 Worker）。
- **测试**：`client-render-test` **72** 条断言、全仓 **33 套件 / 1415** 条断言（`lint` 0 命中、`smoke` 71/71）。
  新增回归：组合预设（名单/层数/共用贴图/层 id 不撞/池子够用）、二级分类**每个桶都非空**、
  `summaryOnly` **不许再砍分类字段**、一次性预设必须给出解释且「重播」必须走 `doPreview`、
  独立会话（`?session=presets` + **预览不许再调 `miliastra_sim`**）、
  README 链接**不许跳出本包**（`../` 一律拒）。
- **发版流程收敛成一处权威**：`docs/` 里那份抄本停在 0.4.0 且给了与现状相反的 npm 凭据说法 ⇒ 现在只指路，
  流程只有 [`.github/release-notes/README.md`](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/blob/main/.github/release-notes/README.md) 一处（**五步 → 六步**：补 npm publish + 真装验证 + `main` 快进）。
- ⚠️ **未做真机验证**：4 个组合预设**离线 preflight 全绿**（池 / 预算 / 层 id / 贴图），
  并且在**内置模拟器**里实测建成（日志：`combo-star-burst 层=6 每层池=64 合计控件=384 loop=true`、
  `combo-snow-blossom 层=4 每层池=104 合计控件=416`）—— 但**真机渲染与粒子帧率仍未验**；
  `<size=N>`、4bit 照旧**未经真机验证**（4bit 默认关）。
- **独立会话是 Host 侧新能力**：`miliastra_sim` 工具**没有**会话参数（它永远打在默认会话上），
  面板要独立会话只能走 `/miliastra/engine` —— 这也是预制效果页**不再用工具**做预览的原因。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.3...v0.6.4

---

<h3 id="en-v0.6.4">🚀 New Features</h3>

- ★ **The presets preview now runs in its own simulator session**: the host always isolated controllers per session
  (`registry` keyed by `ctx.sessionId`), but both the panel and the AI passed an empty ctx ⇒ everything shared the single
  `'default'` project, so previewing a preset **overwrote** the project the simulator page / the AI was using.
  Now `/miliastra/engine` accepts `__session`, `/miliastra/play?session=<name>` stamps the name into the page
  (the footer shows `· 会话 presets`), and the presets page pins the **`presets`** session ⇒ it cannot touch the simulator page
  or the AI's project. ⚠️ Cost: one more runtime (one more Worker). @LoktLin
- ★ **Two-level categories + 4 combo presets**: level 1 **particles / sprites**, level 2 **light & fire / weather / collect & celebrate /
  motion / combos / shapes-along-path**; the dropdown groups by `<optgroup label="level 1 · level 2">`, every row of `preset:"list"`
  carries `category`/`sub`/`isCombo`, and the receipt gains a `categories` summary. @LoktLin
  - **4 combo presets** (multiple layers on one screen; every layer is a **previously verified preset**, only `delay`/`id`/`seed` differ):
    `combo-star-burst` · `combo-coin-fountain` · `combo-snow-blossom` · `combo-peacock-finale`.
    ⚠️ **The pool is sized for the hungriest layer** (64~104): the first cut guessed 60 and `preflight` rejected it on the spot
    ("pool 60 < needs 64") — on a real device that steals slots and drops particles. Total controls **384~416** (37.5%~40.6% of the 1024 budget).
    ⚠️ **A combo shares one image** (the generator writes a single `IMAGE_ID` per project), so each combo picks presets with the same
    image id; per-layer images would require changing the generator and were **not done** (both the receipt and the docs say so).
  - Preset count **13 → 17 particles** (+3 sprites = **20**); the dropdown previously listed particles only and now includes the 3 sprites.
  - The `preset` description in the tool schema was updated (and `gen-readme-tools.mjs --write` was run as required); the schema is
    **31.9 KB**, still inside the 32 KB ratchet.

<h3 id="en-v0.6.4-improve">🎨 Improvements</h3>

- **Basic page rework**: the level selector and the 8-line "level & files" card are gone ⇒ one big line
  (`原神 · levelId` plus active-file count / map size / log runs). The panel now **always follows the current level**
  (**the tool side is unchanged**: an AI `deploy` must still pass an explicit `level`). @LoktLin
  - ★ **New "overall save state" card**: one `miliastra_health {op:'sha',all:true}` call yields a **one-line** verdict —
    ✅ `saved: N / N scripts match what the map embeds` ｜ ⚠️ `M / N scripts not saved` (**named**) ｜ ❔ `cannot tell`
    (it **never claims "saved"** when shas are missing); files that are not mounted (`mounted:false`) are **listed separately**
    and never counted as unsaved.
  - **"Code operations" folded into a collapsed `<details>`**: pick file / inspect / consistency / backup / restore / deploy —
    **not a single feature removed**.
  - Column ownership: left = ① current level + map checkup; right = ② save state & processes.
- **Simulator page slimmed**: the full-width header strip is gone (the only useful part, "refresh engine state", moved to the play
  page toolbar as "刷新状态"; **the error line stayed**), and four left-column cards (play logs / play operations / action timeline /
  acceptance sheet) are **no longer rendered** — the play page itself has the controls and per-frame logs.
  ⚠️ **All the code is kept, only the rendering was removed** (put them back into `playsideKids`); "export GIA" / "reset workspace",
  which had no other home in the panel, moved into the ④ collapsed card. @LoktLin
- **"Control template index / container node index" are no longer two odd inputs you must fill in**: they are **handover values**
  (already read from this level's `.gil`), so the default is a **single read-only line** plus a "fill manually" button;
  when they cannot be read the two inputs **expand automatically** and say what is missing (never silently empty).
  Picking a **sprite** preset now states that `imageId` / pool-per-layer do not apply to it (they are ignored). @LoktLin
- **README got 4 new screenshots** (basic / presets / pixel-art / grid) and **5 wrong facts fixed**
  (`miliastra_code` 8→11 ops, `miliastra_probe` 5 read-only scripts→7 templates, `miliastra_asset` 10→11 ops,
  `vfx-lua` 13→17 particles+3 sprites+two-level categories, panel "three columns"→six pages); `docs/` went **9 → 7 files**
  (two were deleted or moved to the workspace at the author's request). @LoktLin

<h3 id="en-v0.6.4-fix">🐛 Bug Fixes</h3>

- ★ **"After previewing, nothing shows up"** (the author's words: 「啥都没咋回事」) — two causes at once:
  ① **`slash-arc` is a `loop:false` one-shot preset** (done in 1.2 s) ⇒ looking again later, the stage is of course empty.
  The panel now **says so** ("this preset is one-shot: it stops when it finishes, the stage stays empty — that is not a fault")
  and gained a **"replay"** button (= **re-bind** the same Lua, rebuilding the runtime so the script starts from frame 0);
  the "reload view" tooltip now states it **only re-mounts the view and does not replay the animation**. @LoktLin
  ② **The panel sent "image id" to sprite presets** (measured: the author's `10005` — one zero short). Sprites **do** honour `imageId`
  (`SetImage(…, 10005)` ⇒ no such id on the platform, and the simulator cannot draw it ⇒ nothing visible). The root cause was
  **the host's `summaryOnly` returning only `{id, nameZh}`**, which dropped the classification fields ⇒ the panel could not tell a sprite
  from a particle and sent it anyway. @LoktLin
  - Host: `summaryOnly` now keeps `category`/`categoryLabel`/`sub`/`subLabel`/`isCombo`/`shapeKind`/`defaultLoop`
    (all of them decide what is selectable; the receipt is still only **35.5%** of the full one: 15 371 → 5 454 bytes).
  - Panel: incoming rows are normalised **and fall back to the built-in static table** (so grouping, sprite detection and one-shot
    detection also work against an older host).
- **The grid zoom wheel trap** (the author's words: 「这个滚轮咋把网格图也搞小了」): the wheel used to zoom whenever the cursor was
  over the grid, so scrolling the panel with the cursor parked there shrank the image to 29% and looked broken. New rule:
  **a plain wheel never zooms** (no `preventDefault`), **only Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel does**. @LoktLin
  - The zoom floor went **25% → 50%** (at 25% the grid is a thin strip, i.e. lost), the ceiling stays 800%, and **cached values are
    clamped too**.

<h3 id="en-v0.6.4-chores">⚠️ Chores</h3>

- **Both halves changed** (Host and Client) ⇒ after installing or pulling, **restart `dsh web`** (not F5); the presets page adds one
  isolated session (one more Worker).
- **Tests**: `client-render-test` **72** assertions, **33 suites / 1415** assertions repo-wide (`lint` 0 hits, `smoke` 71/71).
  New regressions: combo presets (names / layer counts / shared image / unique layer ids / sufficient pools), **no empty second-level
  bucket**, `summaryOnly` **must not drop the classification fields again**, one-shot presets must explain themselves and "replay" must
  go through `doPreview`, the isolated session (`?session=presets` and **preview must not call `miliastra_sim`**), and
  README links **must not escape the package** (any `../` is rejected).
- **The release procedure now has a single source of truth**: the copy under `docs/` was stuck at 0.4.0 and gave npm-credential advice
  that contradicted reality ⇒ it now only points elsewhere, and the procedure lives **only** in
  [`.github/release-notes/README.md`](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/blob/main/.github/release-notes/README.md)
  (**five steps → six**: npm publish + real install check + `main` fast-forward added).
- ⚠️ **No device verification**: the 4 combo presets are **green in offline preflight** (pools / budget / layer ids / image) and were
  verified to build **in the built-in simulator** (logs: `combo-star-burst layers=6 pool=64 controls=384 loop=true`,
  `combo-snow-blossom layers=4 pool=104 controls=416`) — but **real-device rendering and particle frame rate remain unverified**;
  `<size=N>` and 4-bit are **still unverified** (4-bit is off by default).
- **The isolated session is a host-side capability**: the `miliastra_sim` tool has **no** session parameter (it always targets the
  default session), so a panel that needs isolation must go through `/miliastra/engine` — which is exactly why the presets page
  **no longer uses the tool** for previewing.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.6.3...v0.6.4
